answer: Agents anchor a cipher-sealed thread in a glacier crevasse, locking an 80-credit bond. Each epoch it files tension and temperature; auditors recheck tension against a glacier tension table. A thread 3% off the table, a reused cipher serial, or a copied log burns the bond. First filing 41, the kth 41+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,038,000. A rented-thread ring fails: one thread cannot serve two keys. Honest agents pay 41 once and keep the bond.
